redFlags.label: Flock camera network
redFlags.detail: 71 Flock Safety license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Cedar Rapids's borders in OpenStreetMap. Flock cameras photograph every passing car and feed a search network shared with police agencies across the country. Who runs each camera is recorded for some; cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies are not counted.
